name: @w6w-apps/patreon
description: Manage Patreon campaigns, members, posts, and webhooks via the Patreon API v2. Triggers fire on member, pledge and post events (any event by name) and on new campaigns.

w6w.longDescription:
Patreon is a membership platform creators use to run a recurring-revenue business around their audience: tiers, patrons (members), posts and livestreams, all attached to one or more campaigns.

This app reads a campaign's own data — its tiers and goals, the members currently pledging or following it, and the posts published to it — and looks up a single member or post by id when a workflow already has one from elsewhere (a webhook delivery, a prior list call). It also manages the webhooks Patreon can push events through (new/updated/deleted members, pledge changes, post publish/update/delete), so a workflow can react to patron activity in near real time instead of polling.

Two connection paths are supported: OAuth for a multi-creator integrator building a public product, and a Creator's Access Token for a workflow that only ever needs to manage the one campaign that minted it — no OAuth Client registration or browser redirect required.

Two webhook triggers start a workflow from a campaign: New Pledge and Post Published. Subscribing registers a Patreon webhook for that one event and keeps its signing secret; every delivery's X-Patreon-Signature (Patreon signs with HMAC-MD5) is verified before a run starts.
